name: Adani Ports & SEZ
thesis: Port and logistics leader with strong relative strength. Best traded on tight consolidations after expansion, not on vertical candles.
indicator: Price above 50 EMA and 200 EMA, RSI strong but near upper band, volume supportive, structure remains HH/HL.

name: TVS Motor
thesis: Auto leader with controlled volatility and strong trend persistence. Ideal for 1–4 week continuation if the sector remains in favor.
indicator: Price > 50 EMA > 200 EMA, RSI stable in the mid-60s, shallow pullback, constructive volume behavior.

name: Bajaj Auto
thesis: High-quality auto trend with steady momentum and lower whipsaw risk. Better bought on controlled pullbacks into support than on breakout spikes.
indicator: 50 EMA above 200 EMA, RSI inside the sweet spot, price holding higher lows, volume expands on strength.

name: Hindalco Industries
thesis: Metals leader with strong relative strength and a clean expansion trend. Works best if the breakout holds with follow-through over the next 1–3 weeks.
indicator: Strong HH/HL pattern, price well above both EMAs, RSI constructive, volume confirms breakout participation.

name: Mahindra & Mahindra
thesis: Broad auto leadership and strong institutional participation support continued trend persistence. Best held while higher lows remain intact.
indicator: Price above rising 50/200 EMA, RSI mid-60s, auto breadth supportive, no sharp RSI deterioration.

name: Larsen & Toubro
thesis: Capital goods bellwether in a durable stage-2 trend. Suitable for 2–8 week continuation if infra/capex leadership persists.
indicator: Trend aligned above key EMAs, RSI in bullish band, volume rising on resistance breaks.

name: Bajaj Finance
thesis: Liquid financial leader suitable for continuation if the stock keeps respecting short-term support and the broader tape stays stable.
indicator: Price > EMA stack, RSI above 60, strong liquidity, controlled pullback profile.

name: Anand Rathi Wealth
thesis: High-quality mid-cap showing strong relative strength and clean base behavior. Attractive for 2–6 week breakout continuation if it keeps tightening near highs.
indicator: Stage-2 uptrend, RSI stable, EMAs aligned, price structure remains constructive.

name: Tenneco Clean Air India
thesis: Mid-cap auto ancillary with strong trend pressure and VCP-style tightening potential. Best on a volume-backed pivot break or immediate retest hold.
indicator: Price above both EMAs, RSI in strong zone, higher highs and higher lows intact, strong volume expansion.

name: Cigniti Technologies
thesis: Mid-cap tech name with clean continuation profile. Better risk-reward appears on shallow pullback holds rather than late breakout chase.
indicator: Price > 50 EMA > 200 EMA, RSI stable, orderly trend, modest but supportive volume pickup.

name: Frontier Springs
thesis: Higher-beta small-cap with strong thrust and improving participation. Position size should stay smaller due to volatility.
indicator: Strong HH/HL structure, high volume ratio, RSI firm, but higher execution risk than large-cap leaders.

name: Concord Control
thesis: Small-cap momentum name for satellite exposure only. Works when the stock pauses tightly after expansion and resumes with volume.
indicator: Trend aligned above EMAs, RSI constructive, strong returns and above-average participation.
